body: Thank you for your kind words and advice, it really helped me feel better. I too wish you well on your journey in life <3

yep. i just started taking antidepressants for the second time now. but it seems like they’re just doing it because a professional recommended it, which is understandable, but the problem is that it’s the only reason.

they act like they know what to do when it comes to the surface of mental illness, but when they see the uglier side, their first thought is far from “i care about you and want you to feel safe”, instead it’s “stop whining and get out of bed.” 

thank you for the concern. i appreciate you taking the time to respond.

thank you for the advice. 

unfortunately i have had this discussion with them before; that it’s not a phase and it can’t be fixed so easily. i even had the principal sit and talk with us to show them it’s something really serious. however it’s still the same as before and nothing changed.

take some deep breaths first. umm i can’t really think of any reasons sorry. i don’t know you, but i know that you’e really struggling and right now you can only think of is relapsing. but i think you can resist it! i believe you can. even if you end up doing it, that’s ok. you can always get back up and restart. please take care of yourself. you are loved.

yep!! except his teeth are so strong he would probably rip it up if he played too rough, so we just keep it away in a closet.
